citations.title: CN Announces Executive Changes to COO and CCO Roles

sentences.quote: MONTREAL, Oct. 20, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- CN (TSX: CNR) (NYSE: CNI) announced today the appointments of Patrick Whitehead as Executive Vice-President and Chief Operating Officer as well as Janet Drysdale as Executive Vice-President and Chief Commercial Officer, effective immediately. Patrick's appointment follows the departure of Derek Taylor from the Company.
sentences.text: CN appointed Patrick Whitehead as Executive Vice-President and Chief Operating Officer and Janet Drysdale as Executive Vice-President and Chief Commercial Officer on October 20, 2025, effective immediately, with Whitehead's appointment following the departure of Derek Taylor from the company; Tracy Robinson described the two as key to reaching new levels of operational, commercial and customer service excellence and to delivering shareholder value.
Madeleine Paquin, former CEO of Logistec, joined the board effective October 29, 2025.
Subsequent appointments include Jamie Lockwood as Vice-President, Investor Relations and Special Projects in February 2026 and Matthew Hammond as Vice-President, Engineering in March 2026.
